subject: Re: GLO - new project possibilities
text:
Hi Shivant and Arisha,

We have crated a list of specific requirements regarding compliance and
efficiency metrics. Could you help us answer the following regarding
Encord’s capabilities?

*Compliance:*

   1.

   Can Encord be deployed in a *VPC or On-Premise*?
   2.

   Can it work in an *air-gapped environment* (no external data transfer)?
   3.

   Does it maintain a *full audit log* of all user actions?

*Efficiency:*

   1.

   Can we track *click counts* per annotator/label?
   2.

   Can we track *overwriting rate *of auto-generated labels?
   3.

   Can we report on the *acceptance rate* of auto-labels?
   4.

   Are there *granular time-per-class* metrics available?

Lastly, it would be very helpful if you could clarify which subscription
plans will include these features if they are available.

Thanks for the help!

Best, Mykhailo

subject: Re: Encord & Airbnb - Demo
text:
+Ciara Aguilar <ciara.aguilar@airbnb.com>

Hi Will,

Thanks for reaching out. The team is pulling me into this conversation
because I built the AI annotations program at Uber prior to recently
joining Airbnb. I've listed my main priorities when it comes to annotation
tooling below:

   - *Easy to Navigate Data Representation - *Poor UI for annotators can
   unnecessarily slow the annotation process.
   - *Simple Customization - *Some projects are very simple and require a
   lightweight approach, while others can be much more complex. Having
   flexibility within the tool to customize the annotation design
   - *Real Time Data Dashboards - *Annotator output, key annotation metrics
   (based on the individual annotation), etc.
   - *Built in Quality Checks - *We used to check annotator quality by
   injecting golden data samples with known expected outputs into the
   annotation pipeline. If an annotator's output differed, it would be flagged
   for team leads to address and metrics were used to determine individual
   annotator quality.

The team will have more detailed requirements, but these are some of the
initial priorities that come to my mind when considering a valuable
annotation tool.

Looking forward to our conversation tomorrow,
Steve

Hi James,

Many thanks to you, Max, and Matt for coming in to see us.

It was great to learn more about the platform and also the data collection offering.  Let’s definitely have a follow up call.  In advance of speaking some thoughts from are side include:

- it would interesting to let some of our data operators try out your platform to see how they get on with labelling some of our existing date

- we anticipate needing to outsource 1) data labelling 2) robot trajectory creation 3) egocentric data creation initially in smaller volumes and increasing significantly in the second half of this year.  It would be great to develop a specification for each of these three and get an indication of pricing for a program of work running through this year.

- we are interested in a very wide variety of industrial settings and tasks but some potential places to start include:
— Car / truck factories generally
— Tier 1 auto suppliers manufacturing seats
— Cable and wire harness assembly factories
— textile factories
— industrial laundries
